name: One-on-one meeting planner
why: Builds a one-on-one plan with agenda rules, timing and follow-up, matching the one-on-one system skill.

name: Weekly one-on-one prep keeper
why: Keeps weekly one-on-one prep going, the habit the one-on-one system depends on.

name: Plan a difficult feedback conversation
why: A ready workflow for an opening built on facts, listening questions and one clear request, like the hard conversation skill.

name: Feedback conversation planner
why: Plans what to say and how to say it in a feedback conversation.

name: Hard feedback message writer
why: Writes a feedback message that changes the behaviour without making an enemy, close to the feedback note prompt.

name: Tough feedback note drafter
why: Drafts a short written feedback note from what went wrong.

name: Ask for feedback, then give it
why: Asks for feedback before giving it, the order of operations the kit recommends for managers.

name: Take over a team as its new leader
why: A first message, a listening tour and results agreements for a new leader, matching the 30-day plan prompt.

name: New leader first message writer
why: Writes the new manager's first message to the team, step 4 of the 30-day plan.

name: Set team goals, run one-on-ones and settle decisions
why: Links team goals to a one-on-one plan for managers who need both.

name: Build a practical manager training session
why: Turns coaching content into a group training session for managers.

name: Peer feedback session planner
why: Plans a peer feedback session, useful for group coaching and peer mentoring rounds.
